applePromotionalText: Connect a compatible ring or device, review available wellness records, and sync saved data to your SayDian account on servers located in the United States.
appleDescription:
SayDian connects compatible devices, including supported smart rings and watches, to help you review everyday activity, sleep and available device-reported wellness readings.

ACTIVITY AND SLEEP
Review steps and sleep duration. Distance, estimated energy expenditure, sleep stages and workout details appear only when the connected device provides them. Missing or unsupported information is not presented as a measurement.

COMPATIBLE DEVICE READINGS
Supported devices such as U19S can provide blood pressure, heart rate and blood-oxygen readings. Availability depends on the connected device, its firmware and the app's supported connection channel. These features are not available with every ring or device. The phone does not measure these values by itself.

CONNECT AND SYNCHRONIZE
Connect over Bluetooth, check connection and battery status, and synchronize available records. Device controls vary by model. Keep the device nearby and the app in the foreground for manual synchronization.

YOUR RECORDS AND US CLOUD STORAGE
When signed in, saved activity, sleep, blood-pressure, heart-rate and blood-oxygen records can synchronize to your SayDian account on servers physically located in the United States. Pending uploads remain on your phone until the service acknowledges receipt. Record identifiers help avoid duplicate uploads. The app also keeps an encrypted local health-history cache. Optional services such as weather may process information separately as described in the privacy policy.

PROFILE AND FAMILY CARE
Manage your profile and account. Remote Care lets participating accounts choose permitted activity and sleep categories to share. Sharing requires permission and is not emergency monitoring. Health library provides general educational articles when published content is available in your language.

CHOICES AND SUPPORT
A compatible device is needed for device-generated readings. Sign-in, profile, help, legal documents and account deletion are available without a device. Optional camera, photos and location features ask for the relevant permissions. Manage permissions in iOS Settings and request account deletion under Profile > Account settings.

Wellness and device readings are for everyday reference. SayDian is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, emergency services, disease-risk assessment or medical decision support. Consult a doctor before making medical decisions; seek medical care if you feel unwell. The iOS edition does not provide ECG, AI health advice or paid health-analysis reports.

Support: https://app.saydian.com/global/support
Privacy: https://app.saydian.com/global/privacy-policy
Terms: https://app.saydian.com/global/terms
appleReviewNotes:
SayDian iOS 1.0.2, build 1026

Changes since build 1023
This build adds locally saved pulse-history records and trends, and the Health monitoring settings page for compatible Urion devices. It also fixes missed pulse-result and monitoring-settings updates on iOS. Pulse indices come from the connected device; they are not heart-rate readings, diagnostic conclusions or cloud health-analysis scores. Pulse-index history remains in the encrypted local account/device cache.

Current scope
Compatible rings and watches provide activity and sleep when supported by their hardware and firmware. Confirmed Urion connection channels can also expose device-reported blood pressure, heart rate and blood oxygen. Controls depend on the capabilities reported by the connected device. There is no review-only or account-specific feature unlock. The phone does not measure these values independently. ECG, calibration, disease-risk assessments, medical alerts, AI health advice and paid health reports remain unavailable on iOS. Readings are for everyday wellness reference, not diagnosis, treatment or emergency use. Consult a doctor before medical decisions.

Sign-in
Use the existing email/password supplied in the protected App Review Information fields. Password sign-in does not require an email or SMS verification code. The international service is https://app.saydian.com/global/api/saydian-app/v2. Sign-in, profile, account settings, help, legal documents and account deletion do not require a connected device.

Connection and device settings
Keep the compatible device nearby and disconnected from other companion apps. Open Device > Search for devices, allow Bluetooth access, and select the actual device. Keep SayDian in the foreground during synchronization. For supported Urion devices, open Device > Health monitoring to read the current schedule. Changing a schedule requires an explicit confirmation and a device readback. SayDian does not automatically enable scheduled blood-pressure measurements when a device is connected. Pulse insights > Read device history loads the device's available pulse-history records.

Cloud data and privacy
When signed in, saved activity, sleep, blood-pressure, heart-rate and blood-oxygen records can synchronize to the account's United States service. Unconfirmed uploads remain pending on the phone. Remote Care sharing on iOS remains permission-based and covers activity/sleep only. The published privacy policy and terms are global-appstore-2026-11-04-r4. First-party service data is stored on United States servers, with no automatic China-service fallback. No health data is sent to an AI service by this iOS build. Optional weather/third-party processing is disclosed separately.

Account deletion is available under Profile > Account settings. The app does not enable HealthKit or request Apple Health access; unused vendor-library purpose strings do not activate an Apple Health integration.
